task: Leg 3: the analytic case library (V1) -- Fresnel interface and Fabry-Perot slab against their closed-form laws, with the tolerance kind and basis declared before the run

analytic_cases.basis: Inherited from the reference project's A1 canary (src/run_canary.py, function analyze, branch interface), which requires max|R - exact| and max|T - exact| <= 0.01 at ppw >= 20 for index 1.5 and 3.5. INHERITED, not measured here. It is the achievable floor at that resolution, not a statement about the physics. This leg also reports the measured error so the reader can judge.
analytic_cases.scope_match_reason: The copied project builder places a half-space of index 3.5 behind a single planar interface, with a one-way plane source at normal incidence and vacuum on the incident side. That is exactly the configuration the Fresnel law assumes.

analytic_cases.basis: Inherited from the reference project's A1 canary (src/run_canary.py, function analyze, branch slab), same threshold and same reason as V1-fresnel. INHERITED, not measured here. The slab's optical thickness is 2.1 micrometres, which is the value that project hard-codes and uses in its own exact curve.
analytic_cases.scope_match_reason: The copied project builder places one lossless non-dispersive slab of index 3.5 and optical thickness 2.1 micrometres in vacuum, with a one-way plane source at normal incidence. That is what the Airy law assumes. The dielectric is non-dispersive in this solver, so the lossless assumption holds.

dropped_analytic_cases.reason: Stop condition 1: the law assumes a SYMMETRIC slab of thickness 0.11 micrometres with a guided mode and a modal launch. The copied project builder constructs a planar slab with a plane-wave source and PML ends, not a symmetric waveguide with a modal port. Applying the law there would be an approximation, so the case is dropped rather than approximated.

Stop condition 3: the comparison needs a sphere and a closed-surface flux. The copied project builder has no sphere, so this case needs solver capability that does not exist in this repository yet. Register it as its own step.
